name: Pelayos de la Presa (Spain)
description: Green field within a blue border, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Pelayos de la Presa (a tower and stars on blue and a bend on yellow).
history: Pelayos de la Presa adopted its arms and flag officially in 1995, published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 12 September 1995; the flag is of proportions 2:3, a green cloth with a blue bordure charged at the centre with the municipal arms.
